note: Edit this file to update the public roadmap. Statuses: live | building | planned. The site rebuilds from this on every deploy.

sections.title: Playable Now
sections.blurb: Shipped, tested and running in production at kopitiam.lol.

items.title: 10-level hawker campaign
items.detail: Tiong Bahru to Changi Village — ten real Singapore hawker centres, each with its own earnings target, shift length and three-star thresholds.

items.title: 16 authentic drinks
items.detail: Kopi, Kopi-O, Kopi-C, Kopi Kosong, Siew Dai, Peng, the full Teh range, Yuan Yang, canned sodas and dispenser Bandung & lime juice.

items.title: Three working stations
items.detail: Brew bar with kopi sock and teh pot, canned drinks fridge, and the syrup dispenser — each with its own tab and toolbar.

items.title: Real-time 3D glass mug
items.detail: A Three.js WebGL mug renders your drink as you build it: stacked liquid layers, sloshing physics, floating ice cubes and rising steam.

items.title: Five regulars with preferences
items.detail: Mdm Tan, Uncle Lim, Aunty Lee, Brother Ah Seng and Student Kenneth each order from their own favourites, with hand-drawn vector avatars.

items.title: Story mode for all 10 chapters
items.detail: Uncle Lim walks you through every new hawker centre with a scripted dialogue beat and an equipment unlock notice.

items.title: Voiceovers for three characters
items.detail: Uncle Lim, Aunty Lee and Ah Seng have recorded intro lines that play over their story cards.

items.title: Upgrade shop
items.detail: Five career upgrades, all wired into gameplay: faster pours, coffee and iced-drink payout boosts, a longer customer timer, and the golden mug skin.

items.title: Kopitiam Hall of Fame
items.detail: Local leaderboard with a saved hawker name, best shift earnings and highest level reached.

items.title: Recipe cheat sheet
items.detail: In-game modal grouping every recipe into Kopi, Teh, Soda and Dispenser, reachable from the menu and mid-shift.

items.title: Kopitiam soundscape
items.detail: Looping hawker centre ambience plus synthesised pours, register dings, error buzzes and shop fanfares built on the Web Audio API.

items.title: Cinematic boot sequence
items.detail: Studio logo, then the vintage 9:16 Nanyang poster with tap-to-start, then a 3-2-1 shift countdown.

items.title: Installable PWA
items.detail: Web app manifest, favicons, apple-touch-icon and standalone display — add it to your home screen and it runs full screen.

items.title: iOS app shell
items.detail: Capacitor project with the full Nanyang app-icon set, launch screen, privacy policy and App Store export-compliance flags in place.

items.title: Social preview cards
items.detail: Open Graph and Twitter card metadata so the cover art renders when the game is shared on any platform.

sections.title: In Development
sections.blurb: Actively being worked on — some of it half-wired in the codebase today.

items.title: App Store submission
items.detail: The iOS build is assembled and the validation blockers are cleared. What is left is the store listing, screenshots and review.

items.title: Bundling Three.js locally
items.detail: The 3D mug engine still pulls Three.js from a CDN, so it needs a network round-trip on first load. Vendoring it into the bundle is what makes the 3D mug reliable offline and inside the iOS app.

items.title: Haptic feedback
items.detail: The Capacitor haptics plugin is installed but not yet called. Pours, serves and mistakes should all have their own tap.

items.title: Voiceovers for the last two regulars
items.detail: Mdm Tan and Student Kenneth are still silent — their intro lines are written but not recorded.

items.title: Online leaderboard
items.detail: Scores currently live in browser storage, so the Hall of Fame is per-device. A shared board is the next persistence layer.

sections.title: On the Backlog
sections.blurb: Ideas with no committed date. Order changes often.

items.title: Endless shift mode
items.detail: Free-play beyond level 10 with escalating queues, for score chasing rather than campaign progress.

items.title: Android build
items.detail: Capacitor already supports it; it is a matter of adding the platform and reworking the safe-area handling.

items.title: More of the kopitiam menu
items.detail: Kaya toast, half-boiled eggs and Milo Dinosaur — the other half of a real hawker breakfast order.

items.title: Golden mug in 3D
items.detail: The golden mug upgrade currently changes payouts and the 2D skin, but the WebGL mug does not gild yet.

items.title: Daily challenge
items.detail: One fixed seeded shift per day, same orders for everyone, single score submission.
